comment: Arms of experiments E1b and E1c (brief section 7) plus the two bounds of E0, in queue order. Block 1 decides H1a, block 2 adds H1 and the bounds, block 3 completes the ladder (blocks 1-3 ran for seed 42 in session 1; their results are imported from references/ and not trained again). Block 4 holds controls added after session 1 (they depart from the no-tuning rule I5 on purpose and are never a proposed method). Blocks 5 and 6 check the HO-FL authors' statements on the zeroth-order updates under the authors' own settings: block 5 on AG News (the uniform highest boundary of the paper's Table 9, and the default run again with the attribution probe, which must reproduce session 1 exactly), block 6 the Top-FO-Only ablation of the rebuttal on SQuAD. Block 7 is a pilot of E3 (brief section 7): two cells of the Qwen grid, HO-FL's default with one preferred T1 device faulty in rounds 41-80; A-b0.75-attr is their fault-free twin (evaluated every 4 rounds with per-class accuracy, as E3 prescribes). Blocks 4-7 run for the first seed of a session only. A fault_spec path is relative to the repository root. An arm with its own 'rounds' is scaled from the 160 rounds of the base; 'uniform_cut': 'highest' means the largest tier cut of the model.

arms.name: A-b0
arms.what: HO-FL baseline, uniform sampling (equal-weight mean over all reports)

arms.name: C-b0
arms.what: fo_mean, uniform sampling: each layer averages its first-order reports only

arms.name: A-b0.75
arms.what: HO-FL baseline, biased sampling (the HO-FL default)

arms.name: Ax2-b0
arms.what: step-size control: baseline with the server step doubled

arms.name: Ax3-b0
arms.what: step-size control: baseline with the server step tripled

arms.name: B-b0
arms.what: fo_diluted without zeroth-order updates, uniform sampling: A minus B is the net contribution of the zeroth-order updates

arms.name: B-b0.75
arms.what: fo_diluted without zeroth-order updates, biased sampling

arms.name: fedavg
arms.what: FedAvg: every client trains every layer first-order (upper bound)

arms.name: decomfl
arms.what: DeComFL: every client trains every layer zeroth-order (lower bound)

arms.name: C-b0.75
arms.what: fo_mean, biased sampling

arms.name: D-b0
arms.what: fo_mean without zeroth-order updates, uniform sampling: partial-layer first-order training only

arms.name: D-b0.75
arms.what: fo_mean without zeroth-order updates, biased sampling

arms.name: A-b0.75-attr
arms.what: HO-FL default (beta=0.75) again with the attribution probe; trains exactly like A-b0.75 of session 1 (only read-only probes and evaluations added) and is the fault-free twin of the E3 pilot

arms.name: Au24-b0
arms.what: HO-FL, every client at the highest zeroth-order boundary, beta=0 (paper Table 9: 63.22 on Qwen / AG News)

arms.name: Bu24-b0
arms.what: the same with the bottom frozen (Top-FO-Only at the uniform boundary): zeroth-order updates off, direct averaging

arms.name: A-b0.75-squad
arms.what: HO-FL default (beta=0.75) on SQuAD (paper Table 3 and rebuttal: F1 86.92 on Qwen)

arms.name: B-b0.75-squad
arms.what: Top-FO-Only (bottom frozen, direct averaging) on SQuAD, beta=0.75 (rebuttal: F1 83.65 on Qwen)

arms.name: B2-lr20
arms.what: E3 pilot: HO-FL default (B2) with the preferred T1 device's local learning rate x20 in rounds 41-80

arms.name: B2-label
arms.what: E3 pilot: HO-FL default (B2) with every label of the preferred T1 device shifted to the next class in rounds 41-80

arms.name: Cx2-b0
arms.what: control: fo_mean with the server step doubled (compare with Ax2-b0: same step, different electorate)

arms.name: fedavg-x2
arms.what: control: FedAvg with the server step doubled (is the upper bound itself under-stepped?)

arms.name: C-b0-r480
arms.what: control: fo_mean, uniform sampling, three times as many rounds

arms.name: A-b0-r480
arms.what: control: baseline, uniform sampling, three times as many rounds
